claim: Brown adipose tissue (BAT) plays an essential role in metabolic homeostasis by dissipating energy via thermogenesis through uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1).
source: Brown adipose tissue (BAT) plays an essential role in metabolic homeostasis by dissipating energy via thermogenesis through uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1).
evidence: This is established scientific knowledge about BAT function and UCP1's role in thermogenesis.

claim: TAF7L is an important regulator of white adipose tissue (WAT) differentiation.
source: Previously, we reported that the TATA-binding protein associated factor 7L (TAF7L) is an important regulator of white adipose tissue (WAT) differentiation.
evidence: This claim references previous work by the authors, indicating it is supported by prior published research.

claim: TAF7L serves as a molecular switch between brown fat and muscle lineages in vivo and in vitro.
source: In this study, we show that TAF7L also serves as a molecular switch between brown fat and muscle lineages in vivo and in vitro.
evidence: This is a primary finding of the study, supported by experimental data presented in the manuscript.

claim: In adipose tissue, TAF7L-containing TFIID complexes associate with PPARγ.
source: In adipose tissue, TAF7L-containing TFIID complexes associate with PPARγ to mediate DNA looping between distal enhancers and core promoter elements.
evidence: This is a primary finding supported by experimental data, including immunoprecipitation experiments described in the methods.

claim: TAF7L-containing TFIID complexes mediate DNA looping between distal enhancers and core promoter elements.
source: In adipose tissue, TAF7L-containing TFIID complexes associate with PPARγ to mediate DNA looping between distal enhancers and core promoter elements.
evidence: This is supported by 3C (chromosome conformation capture) experimental data described in the methods section.

claim: The tissue-specific TAF7L subunit in TFIID functions to promote long-range chromatin interactions during BAT lineage specification.

evidence: This is presented as a conclusion based on the experimental findings, involving interpretation of the data.
